subject: Acme Health SOC 2 Discovery - Post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wright <sam.wright@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Health SOC 2 Discovery - Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the candid conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so the security team has what they need to evaluate Redwood for serving PHI-adjacent workloads within Acme Health.

Pain points / goals you shared:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence and recent pen test summary to satisfy internal risk review.
- Audit/log retention: 13 months required for product telemetry and access logs.
- Data residency: US-only regions for production and backups.
- Data handling: request for DPA language around processing, subprocessor list, and breach notification SLA (48 hours).
- Need clarity on access controls, IAM integrations (SAML + SCIM), and support for customer-managed KMS.

What Redwood can provide (summary):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — we shared the 2026 report below.
- Pen test summary and remediation timeline — redacted summary attached. Full report available under NDA.
- Audit logs retention configurable up to 24 months; default retention 90 days but can be extended to 13 months per route with a retention policy.
- US-only region deployment available for Dedicated and Private — we can confirm region and backup geography.
- DPA (attached v3.1) includes standard breach notification terms; happy to discuss edits for enterprise legal.
- IAM: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning supported; we also support RBAC and VPC peering for Private deployments. Customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS and GCP KMS supported in Private.

Attachments & links we can share now:
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (attached)
- redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.zip (attached; redacted findings)
- Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf (attached)
- Shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/share/Acme-Health/SOC2-2026
- DocuSign (DPA route): https://docusign.net/Acme-Redwood/DPA-v3.1

Proposed next steps:
1) If helpful, sign the mutual NDA / DPA route (we can start DocuSign) — Priya, please confirm the right legal contact.
2) We can provide the full (unredacted) pen test report under an executed NDA.
3) Marissa/Neha to schedule a follow-up with your InfoSec team next week to walk the SOC 2 report and retention configuration.
4) Technical contact (Vivek) to pull sample audit logs and a short demo of retention policy admin for your engineers.

Would you like us to route the full pen test report under NDA now, or should we wait until legal signs the DPA?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security & Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.zip]
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf]

From: Sam Wright <sam.wright@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme Health SOC 2 Discovery - Post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — solid recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2 report: we need the full report (not just the summary) and the auditor letter. We can accept redacted PII but need the full control testing details.
- Pen test: we require a vendor statement + remediation timeline. Is the full report available under NDA?
- Retention: 13 months is a minimum. Can you confirm whether logs are exportable (S3 push / API) for long-term archival?
- DPA: our legal team will review but if you can start DocuSign that speeds things up.
- KMS: confirm support for customer-managed keys in Dedicated + Private. For hosted, we need to understand encryption at rest and key access controls.

Also looping in Priya (Legal) — Priya, can you advise who on legal should own the DPA review?

On timing — we'd like to complete compliance review in the next 3 weeks if possible.

Best,
Sam
Head of InfoSec, Acme Health

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Health SOC 2 Discovery - Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks — we can absolutely proceed on the timeline. Quick answers inline and next actions below: 

- Full SOC 2: we can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report and auditor letter under our standard NDA. I've attached the certified 2026 report (we provided an excerpt in the call) and will route the unredacted file once we have NDA signed.
- Pen test: the redacted summary is attached. The full vendor report is available under NDA; the pen test vendor statement and remediation tracker are included in the zip.
- Logs export: yes — audit logs are exportable via S3 sink or API. We can set up a deliverable pipeline to push logs to your S3 bucket for archival (we typically provide daily batches in JSONL).
- KMS & encryption: Hosted: AES-256 with provider-managed keys; Dedicated/Private: support for customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP KMS). We will provide key separation docs and access controls for the Dedicated option.

Next actions I will take this week:
- Start DocuSign route for DPA v3.1 (to Priya) — link will be shared when initiated.
- Share the access instructions for S3 export + sample log schema (attachment).
- Coordinate delivery of full SOC 2 + pen test report under NDA once DPA/NDA is executed.
- Schedule follow-up call with your InfoSec team (propose Thu 3/18 or Fri 3/19 morning PST). Please indicate preferred time.

Let me know if you'd prefer a live walkthrough of the SOC 2 controls vs. a docs-first approach. Happy to do either.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Security & Sales
